checks.name: gap_semantic_match
oracle_gap_terms: RoPE context extension methods are diverse heuristics without a unified theory for choosing dimension-wise scaling.
Training-free long-context extension can distort local or middle-frequency positional information even when the final context window is longer.
7B-scale long-context work needs cheap extension methods that avoid fine-tuning and preserve retrieval/dialogue behavior.
